description: The OpenLogos context menu (B077, specs/22 §4.2): for a word in a translation, in Greek and in Hebrew, a selection in one verse and across verses, a spot, a selection and a passage link in a note (dock and Notes tab), a tab (hidden, linked, active, alone), a column (first, last, only) and the background, the header (title, the focus change run first, the dispatch context), every section and row with disabled reasons in words, rows in full where their arguments matter, and choosing rows; then the menu's new commands (tab.open_edition, tab.close_others and the host hand-offs) with refusals and undo. Every host runs it.
